data.raw_text:
[7:12PM] #Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate 

Busy traffic movement from Ragolis inward Benson, and towards Ikorodu Interchange.
Good traffic flow from the Interchange inward Aleje.
Good traffic conditions from Aleje connecting to Sabo.
Slightly busy traffic from Sabo inward Ilepo Oba, primarily due to increased rider and pedestrian activities.
Encouraging traffic movement beyond Ilepo Oba, connecting to LASTMA Yard, Jubilee, Okegbegun, and up to First Gate, although approaching First Gate is slightly busy due to traffic alternation and pedestrian activities.
Good traffic flow inward Odogunyan, as well as on the return journey.
Smooth traffic movement from Ikorodu Interchange inward along the stretch of Oba Ayangburen Road to Ojobo, with a similar smooth return journey.
Unimpeded traffic flow from Ojobo connecting Ladega, Itumoja, Itunmeko, down to Ota Ona.
Good traffic conditions along the entire stretch of Ota Ona, connecting to Grammar School, Erunwen, Radio, and towards Itamaga, with a similarly smooth return journey.

#FollowLASTMA

Good traffic flow from Awori to Ahammadiya, Ajala, and further to Ijaye, with good vehicular movement.
Good traffic conditions from Casso, Kola, and Moshalashi, connecting to Ajegunle.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[8:30PM] #Alausa_Ikeja #TrafficUpdate 

Busy vehicular movement on Obafemi Awolowo Way from Balogun, approaching Allen Intersection, and onward Radio Junction. 
This congestion is attributed to a containerized trailer that has broken down, blocking the entire road from Alausa Bus Stop to Ojota on Kudirat Abiola Way.
Efforts are underway, with officers on ground to mitigate the impact of the breakdown and ensure traffic flow.
Appreciable traffic movement is observed on other corridors within Alausa and Ikeja, which are currently unaffected by the breakdown.

#FollowLASTMA

[8:43PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

Good traffic movement in and out on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway.
Fast-moving traffic on the stretch of Isheri Olowora, River Valley, VIS, Omole Gate, down to Omole Junction.
Improved traffic flow observed towards Excellence, Yaya Abaton, Kayode, Caterpillar, Odo Eran, and Wempco, with a smooth return journey from Wempco to Odo Eran and Caterpillar.
Encouraging traffic movement from Wempco inw Lateef Jakande, connecting to Omole Junction, Omole Gate, VIS, River Valley, and further to Isheri Olowora, with fast-moving traffic.

Officers are on ground, effectively managing the traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
